description:
The Shogun T1000 is a great option for your daily commute or neighborhood adventures. Built with a lightweight aluminum frame and an alloy crown front suspension fork, rest assured that you're getting a smooth and comfortable ride. The 21 speed drivetrain is equipped with easy to use twist shifters, allowing you to effortlessly change gears and tackle a wide variety of terrains. The front and rear linear side pull brakes provide reliable stopping power in any weather conditions. Plus, with the deluxe padded saddle and quick release height adjustable seat post, you can customize your ride for maximum comfort. Designed with lightweight alloy wheels and smooth hybrid road tires, the Shogun T1000 is both efficient and nimble. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, or simply enjoying a leisurely ride around the neighborhood, the 700c Shogun T1000 has you covered.

You can find this bike exclusively at Walmart!
